title: SAVeR$^2$: Reasoning-based Safety Alignment for Large Reasoning Models via Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2611.07482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved impressive performance via explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, yet this process introduces critical safety risks. We formalize LRM safety objectives as requiring non-malicious reasoning and answers, safety consistency, and explicit intent identification. We argue that existing alignment methods suffer from poor adversarial generalization, a significant ``safety tax'' on reasoning, and unfaithful coarse-grained rewards, primarily due to their neglect of the LRM's intrinsic reasoning capabilities for safety. To address these, we propose \textbf{SAVeR$^2$}, a novel \textbf{S}afety \textbf{A}lignment method via \textbf{R}ewards with \textbf{R}easoning capability. SAVeR$^2$ decomposes the safety objective into four fine-grained verifiable reward signals and utilizes a difficulty-aware data selection strategy to stabilize training. translated_title: SAVeR²：基于推理的、通过可验证奖励实现的大型推理模型安全对齐
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRMs）通过显式的思维链（CoT）推理取得了令人瞩目的性能，然而这一过程也引入了关键的安全风险。我们将LRM的安全目标形式化为：要求推理与回答非恶意、保持安全一致性以及进行显式的意图识别。我们认为，现有对齐方法存在对抗泛化能力差、推理能力遭受显著“安全税”以及粗粒度奖励不忠实等问题，其主要原因在于忽视了LRM自身内在的、可服务于安全的推理能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SAVeR²，一种新颖的基于具备推理能力的奖励的安全对齐方法。SAVeR²将安全目标分解为四个细粒度的可验证奖励信号，并利用难度感知的数据选择策略来稳定训练。至关重要的是，我们引入了一种保持推理能力的梯度投影……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: SAVeR²提出了一种基于可验证奖励的推理式安全对齐方法，将安全目标分解为四个细粒度的可验证奖励信号，并结合难度感知的数据选择与保持推理能力的梯度投影，在提升大型推理模型安全性的同时避免损害其推理能力。
en_tdlr: SAVeR² is a reasoning-based safety alignment method that decomposes safety objectives into four fine-grained verifiable reward signals, using difficulty-aware data selection and reasoning-preserving gradient projection to improve the safety of Large Reasoning Models without sacrificing their reasoning capabilities.
